summary: Implemented the refactor for issue #201 without running any tests or code. Changes: new monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver, no ignite dependency) and monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save/finalize); new plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, moved from TensorBoardImageHandler._add_2_or_3_d. SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver and TensorBoardImageHandler are now thin ignite wrappers that keep their constructor, attach and __call__ behaviour. Added tests: tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. Added docs entries in docs/source/data.rst. Nothing is committed. Tests are unexecuted. Preserved an existing quirk: 3D multi-channel TensorBoard plotting only writes the first channel. The segmentation handler's dtype argument remains unused, as before.
